title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.09928v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong visual understanding, yet the internal features that cause these behaviors remain difficult to identify, audit, or control. While applicable to post-hoc inspection, hidden states that are decomposed into interpretable feature directions using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) neither readily isolate which features are changed by multimodal training, nor are they directly useful for targeted control. We introduce MMDiff, a multimodal model-diffing framework that trains multimodal SAEs and turns them into feature-level interfaces for discovering and controlling multimodal behavior. MMDiff supports three uses: (i) feature isolation, by diffing a base-LM SAE against its multimodal-adapted counterpart to identify features altered by multimodal training; (ii) task-specific feature detection, via per-token contrastive firing analysis that isolates causal features; and (iii) feature-leve

translated_title: 面向特征发现与控制的多模态模型对比方法
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）展现出强大的视觉理解能力，然而引发这些行为的内部特征仍然难以识别、审计或控制。虽然使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将隐藏状态分解为可解释的特征方向适用于事后检查，但这些方法既无法轻易分离出哪些特征因多模态训练而发生改变，也无法直接用于针对性控制。我们提出了MMDiff，一个多模态模型对比框架，它训练多模态稀疏自编码器并将其转化为特征级接口，用于发现和控制多模态行为。MMDiff支持三种用途：（i）特征隔离，通过对比基础语言模型的SAE与其多模态适配版本，识别被多模态训练改变的特征；（ii）任务特定特征检测，通过逐token的对比激活分析分离出因果特征；（iii）特征级控制（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了MMDiff多模态模型对比框架，通过训练多模态稀疏自编码器并将其作为特征级接口，实现多模态大语言模型中被多模态训练改变的特征的发现、隔离与针对性控制。
en_tdlr: MMDiff is a multimodal model-diffing framework that trains multimodal sparse autoencoders as feature-level interfaces to discover, isolate, and control the features altered by multimodal training in multimodal large language models.
